title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?

claim.summary: SciExam for ENSO has agents turn raw ocean-atmosphere observations into five monthly ENSO indices, write and freeze their own diagnostics, and build a low-order stochastic model that hidden graders score against a published reference on statistics, withheld-variable reconstruction and held-out forecasts.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; scientific temporal analysis

modules.name: Phased workflow with frozen self-written diagnostics
modules.scope_reason: Gated phases, agent-authored checks frozen before model development, and withheld grader scores constrain feedback for any modelling problem, and the authors separate this execution protocol from the ENSO data and graders.
